literature_notes: The only ledger line (L1) reports a bRIL domain inserted between A226 and L227 of the full-length consensus OR52 construct (OR52cs, 1–313) for structural studies. In OR52N2 canonical numbering, position 226 is A (matching the paper) and position 227 is V (the paper's OR52cs has L at that position — a one-residue mismatch consistent with OR52cs being a consensus sequence, not OR52N2 itself). Critically, the authoritative topology landmarks place residues 222–242 in the INTRACELLULAR loop 3 (ICL3), between TM5 (196–221) and TM6 (243–263). The bRIL-in-ICL3 strategy is the standard GPCR structural-biology approach and is explicitly intracellular. It does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No other ledger lines exist. Accordingly, zero extracellular surface tag sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: bRIL domain inserted between A226 and L227 of OR52cs for structural studies; this junction falls in ICL3 (intracellular loop 3, residues 222–242 in OR52N2) and is therefore an intracellular insertion, not a surface tag site.
